title: gmaio pipeline parameters
description: Genome & metagenome all-in-one: isolate/metagenome x Illumina/Nanopore

input.description: Path to the samplesheet CSV (not required for --mode download_dbs).

comparison_reads.description: Samplesheet of external reads (sample, fastq_1, fastq_2) to QC/host-remove and map against this run's final dereplicated bin representatives and gene catalogue, for cross-cohort comparison -- never assembled or binned. illumina_metagenome only. Sample IDs must not collide with --input's or --comparison_assemblies's.

comparison_assemblies.description: Samplesheet of external, pre-binned assemblies (sample, assembly) whose genes are folded into the expanded gene catalogue, for cross-cohort comparison -- never binned. illumina_metagenome only. Sample IDs must not collide with --input's or --comparison_reads's.

container_base.description: Directory holding local .sif images for bespoke tools.

aviary_container.description: Optional explicit Aviary .sif path. If unset, AVIARY_RECOVER uses ${container_base}/aviary_0.13.0.sif.

tracs_container.description: Optional explicit TRACS .sif path. If unset, TRACS_* use the quay.io biocontainer. Needed only when that image crashes with exit status 132 (SIGILL): TRACS compiles with -march=native, so the published build is tied to bioconda's build-host CPU. Build containers/tracs_1.1.1.def on the compute host -- see docs/containers.md.

databases.title: Reference databases
databases.description: Paths to pre-built databases. Override per profile, or build with --mode download_dbs.

gtdbtk_db.description: GTDB-Tk reference data directory, exported as GTDBTK_DATA_PATH for GTDBTK_CLASSIFYWF. All modes.

checkm2_db.description: CheckM2 database directory, passed to CHECKM2_PREDICT as its diamond reference DB. All modes.

checkm1_db.description: CheckM1 database directory. CheckM1 has no env-var override, so this is applied via 'checkm data setRoot' before each CHECKM1_LINEAGEWF run. Only used when run_checkm1=true.

singlem_metapackage.description: SingleM metapackage directory, exported as SINGLEM_METAPACKAGE_PATH for SINGLEM_PIPE read profiling. Metagenome modes only.

rpkm_singlem_marker_dbs.description: Optional directory of prebuilt SingleM marker DIAMOND .dmnd files for RPKM normalization.

rpkm_singlem_marker_lengths.description: Optional SingleM marker stats TSV for RPKM normalization; must contain Gene and avg_len columns.

sylph_db.description: Sylph database — path or glob of the .syldb file(s) to profile against.

sylph_tax_metadata.description: sylph-tax metadata path/glob matching the selected sylph_db files; set to enable taxonomy + merge.

bakta_db.description: Bakta database directory, passed to Bakta's --db flag for isolate/reference annotation. Isolate modes only.

dram_db.description: DRAM database directory, used by DRAM_ANNOTATE* processes for gene-catalogue annotation (metagenome modes) and per-bin annotation via run_dram_bins (all modes).

genomad_db.description: geNomad database directory, used by GENOMAD_ENDTOEND for virus/plasmid prediction in the mobile-elements subworkflow. All modes.

checkv_db.description: CheckV database directory, used by CHECKV_ENDTOEND for quality assessment in the mobile-elements subworkflow. All modes.

eggnog_db.description: eggNOG data directory, exported as EGGNOG_DATA_DIR and passed to Aviary's --eggnog-db-path during binning/annotation. Metagenome modes only.

amrfinder_db.description: AMRFinderPlus database directory (null = use the container's bundled DB). Used when skip_annotation=false in isolate modes.

host_ref.description: Host reference FASTA used to build a Cleanifier index when cleanifier_db is not supplied.

cleanifier_db.description: Pre-built Cleanifier .filter index. If unset, host_ref is indexed with cleanifier index.

cleanifier_nobjects.description: Optional -n/--nobjects override for cleanifier index; defaults to estimated FASTA bases.

genomespot_models.description: GenomeSPOT trained-models directory, used for genome-trait prediction when run_genomespot=true. All modes.

bakta_reference_proteins.description: Optional proteins/GBFF file passed to Bakta --proteins.

reference_genomes.description: Directory of external reference genome FASTAs (metagenome modes). When set, references are dereplicated together with the HQ MAGs, reads are mapped to that combined set, and reference proteins are added to an expanded gene catalogue (+DRAM+RPKM).

reference_genome_extension.description: Comma-separated file extensions to glob under reference_genomes (gzipped inputs are decompressed).

reference_genomes_checkm2.description: Optional CheckM2 quality_report.tsv for the reference genomes; every reference must appear in it or the run fails. If unset, CheckM2 is run on the references.

reference_genomes_taxonomy.description: Classify the reference genomes with GTDB-Tk. They are renamed with a reserved prefix before GTDB-Tk (to avoid GCA_/GCF_ accession collisions) and appear in the published GTDB-Tk summary with their original names restored (metagenome modes).

reference_genomes_in_catalogue.description: Include reference_genomes proteins in the expanded gene catalogue. Set false to keep references out of the catalogue (e.g. dereplication/strain comparison only) while still using --comparison_assemblies for catalogue expansion -- avoids double-counting when the references were themselves derived from the comparison assembly. Only meaningful when reference_genomes is set (metagenome modes).

download_db.description: Comma-list of DB names to download (or 'all'), written under db_outdir. Only used with --mode download_dbs.

skip_qc.description: Skip read QC (FASTP for Illumina, FASTPLONG for Nanopore). All modes.

skip_sylph.description: Skip sylph read-level taxonomic profiling (SYLPH_SKETCH/SYLPH_PROFILE, + sylph-tax if sylph_tax_metadata is set). Metagenome modes only.

skip_singlem.description: Skip SingleM community profiling of raw reads. Metagenome modes only.

skip_host_removal.description: Skip Cleanifier host-read removal. Requires cleanifier_db or host_ref when enabled. Metagenome modes only.

skip_assembly.description: Skip assembly: SPAdes (illumina_metagenome), Shovill (illumina_isolate), myloasm (nanopore_metagenome), or Autocycler (nanopore_isolate). All modes.

skip_binning.description: Skip the Aviary binning block, which also skips everything nested inside it (CheckM, dereplication, genome mapping, taxonomy/QC, marker-gene tree). Metagenome modes only.

skip_dereplication.description: Skip cross-sample dereplication (COVERM_CLUSTER/_HQ/_HQ_REF); all bins are used as 'representatives' instead. Metagenome modes only.

skip_read_mapping.description: Skip CoverM read mapping to assemblies (all modes) and, in metagenome modes, to representative/HQ/dereplicated genome sets.

skip_mapping_assessment.description: Skip MAPPING_ASSESS (bases-mapped / percent-of-sequenced-bases metrics alongside CoverM's read Count) for every read-mapping step. Has no effect if --skip_read_mapping is set. All modes.

skip_gene_catalogue.description: Skip gene prediction (PYRODIGAL_SCAFFOLDS) and the gene-catalogue subworkflow (CD-HIT clustering, CDS extraction, membership, optional DRAM annotation). Metagenome modes only.

skip_rpkm.description: Skip SingleM-marker-normalized gene-catalogue abundance (RPKM). Requires skip_qc=false and skip_assembly=false or skip_gene_catalogue=false. Metagenome modes only.

skip_annotation.description: Skip functional annotation: DRAM (metagenome gene catalogue / per-bin) or, in isolate modes, Bakta+MLST+AMRFinderPlus+ISEScan together (isolate modes can't toggle these independently). All modes.

skip_taxonomy.description: Skip GTDB-Tk classification (+ name restoration for reference genomes). Also required to be false for reference_genomes_taxonomy, marker_tree_include_references, and run_marker_tree. All modes.

skip_checkm.description: Skip CheckM2 completeness/contamination prediction. Required to be false for --reference_genomes. All modes.

skip_mobile_elements.description: Skip the mobile-elements subworkflow: geNomad virus/plasmid prediction, CheckV quality assessment, and ANI-based clustering. All modes.

skip_porechop.description: Skip Porechop adapter trimming during long-read QC. Nanopore modes only.

skip_dorado_polish.description: Skip Dorado long-read consensus polishing after assembly. Nanopore modes only.

skip_polypolish.description: Skip Polypolish short-read hybrid polishing of the long-read assembly (only meaningful for samples that also have short reads). nanopore_isolate only.

skip_comparative.description: Skip the isolate-comparative subworkflow (FastANI, ParSNP+Gubbins, Panaroo(+IQTree), chewBBACA). Conflicts with skip_annotation=true (comparative analysis needs Bakta output). Isolate modes only.

run_nonpareil.description: Run Nonpareil sequencing-coverage/diversity estimation on clean reads. Metagenome modes only.

run_genomespot.description: Run GenomeSPOT genome-trait prediction on representative genomes. All modes.

run_barrnap.description: Run Barrnap rRNA prediction on representative genomes. All modes.

run_dram_bins.description: Run per-bin DRAM annotation + distillation, in addition to gene-catalogue DRAM annotation. All modes.

run_checkm1.description: Run CheckM1 lineage_wf alongside CheckM2; feeds hq_quality_source classification. All modes.

hq_quality_source.description: Which CheckM report(s) classify a bin as HQ; a bin is HQ if it passes in any selected report.

within_sample_dereplication.description: Dereplicate bins within each sample ('sample') or each samplesheet group ('group'), selecting HQ MAGs within that unit; 'none' disables it. Independent of skip_dereplication (across-all-samples): across-only = skip_dereplication false + none; within-only = skip_dereplication true + sample/group; both = skip_dereplication false + sample/group. Requires skip_binning=false. Metagenome modes only.

run_fastani.description: Run FastANI within the isolate-comparative subworkflow (only takes effect when skip_comparative=false). Isolate modes only.

run_parsnp.description: Run ParSNP+Gubbins core-genome alignment within the isolate-comparative subworkflow (only takes effect when skip_comparative=false). Isolate modes only.

run_panaroo.description: Run Panaroo pangenome analysis within the isolate-comparative subworkflow (only takes effect when skip_comparative=false). Isolate modes only.

run_chewbbaca.description: Run chewBBACA cgMLST within the isolate-comparative subworkflow (only takes effect when skip_comparative=false). Isolate modes only.

run_tree.description: Build an IQTree tree from the Panaroo core-gene alignment; only takes effect when run_panaroo is also true. Isolate modes only.

run_marker_tree.description: Build a marker-gene tree of MAGs + selected GTDB references after GTDB-Tk. Requires skip_taxonomy=false. Metagenome modes only.

run_instrain.description: Run inStrain strain-level comparison of samples against the shared cross-sample dereplicated reference set (bowtie2 -> profile -> compare -> summary). Answers whether two samples carry the same strain, which 95% ANI dereplication cannot. Requires skip_binning=false and skip_dereplication=false. illumina_metagenome only -- inStrain's SNV model assumes short, low-error reads; use run_tracs for nanopore.

run_tracs.description: Run TRACS strain/transmission comparison against the shared cross-sample dereplicated reference set (build-db -> align -> combine -> distance -> cluster), producing pairwise SNP distances and transmission clusters. Builds its reference database from the pipeline's own MAGs, so no GTDB download or network access is needed. Requires skip_binning=false and skip_dereplication=false. Metagenome modes only.

strain_genome_source.description: Which cross-sample genome set both strain tools map to: 'hq_representatives' (default; HQ MAGs extracted from the full bin set, then dereplicated, so every cluster is represented by an HQ genome), 'hq_representatives_direct' (dereplicate first, then keep the representatives that pass HQ), 'representatives' (all cluster representatives, any quality), or 'hq_ref_representatives' (HQ MAGs dereplicated together with external reference_genomes). All hq_* options need a CheckM report (skip_checkm=false or run_checkm1=true). Metagenome modes only.

strain_min_completeness.description: Minimum CheckM completeness for a genome to enter the strain reference set (MIMAG high-quality default), applied on top of strain_genome_source. Incompleteness shrinks the comparable fraction of a genome and biases calls toward 'same strain', which is the conservative direction. Genomes absent from the CheckM report (e.g. external reference_genomes) are kept. Metagenome modes only.

strain_max_contamination.description: Maximum CheckM contamination for a genome to enter the strain reference set (MIMAG high-quality default). Stricter than the pipeline HQ filter (completeness - 3*contamination >= 50), which admits e.g. 95%-complete / 15%-contaminated bins. Contamination is the dangerous direction: foreign contigs collect reads from unrelated populations and generate spurious SNPs, producing false 'different strain' calls. Metagenome modes only.

catalogue_clusterer.description: NOT CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED — accepted but ignored; the gene catalogue always uses CD-HIT regardless of this value.

catalogue_identities.description: Comma-separated CD-HIT identities; first is the primary catalogue (used for CDS/membership/DRAM).

rpkm_min_read_length.description: Minimum selected R1 read length retained for RPKM DIAMOND blastx.

core_alignment.description: NOT CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED — accepted but ignored; isolate-comparative always runs ParSNP (gated by run_parsnp), there is no Snippy path.

tree_builder.description: NOT CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED — accepted but ignored; the isolate-comparative core-gene tree always uses IQTree (gated by run_tree), there is no RAxML path. Not to be confused with marker_tree_builder, which is wired up.

sylph_profile_args.description: Optional extra arguments for sylph profile.

aviary_extra_binners.description: Optional extra binner name(s) passed to Aviary recover's --extra-binners (e.g. 'comebin' or 'comebin maxbin2'). Metagenome modes only.

marker_tree_builder.description: Tree builder for the metagenome marker-gene tree.

marker_tree_genome_source.description: Which user genomes to place in the marker-gene tree. 'hq_representatives' uses the HQ-first-then-dereplicated set (HQ MAGs, completeness - 3x contamination >= 50, extracted from the full bin set and then clustered among themselves) and bypasses the min_completeness/max_contamination filter.

marker_tree_min_completeness.description: CheckM2 completeness threshold for genomes placed in the marker-gene tree.

marker_tree_max_contamination.description: CheckM2 contamination threshold for genomes placed in the marker-gene tree.

marker_tree_use_closest.description: Select closest reference genomes by GTDB-Tk tree topology.

marker_tree_use_related.description: Select one reference per order sharing a bin's order but not its family.

marker_tree_closest_n.description: Number of closest reference leaves per genome.

marker_tree_exclude_pattern.description: Extra regex to exclude leaf names when selecting closest references.

marker_tree_reference_accessions.description: Optional file of GB_/RS_ accessions to add to the marker-gene tree verbatim.

marker_tree_include_references.description: Place the external --reference_genomes in the marker-gene tree alongside the MAGs. Requires --reference_genomes and runs GTDB-Tk on the references (they are always placed, regardless of CheckM2 quality).

dorado_model.description: Dorado basecalling model name/path, used when basecalling POD5 input.

dorado_barcode_kit.description: Optional Dorado barcode kit name for POD5 basecalling/demux.

force_dorado_basecalling.description: Force POD5 basecalling with Dorado even when direct long-read FASTQ is also supplied for a sample. Nanopore modes only.

long_read_type.description: Autocycler read type. Used by AUTOCYCLER_ASSEMBLE in nanopore_isolate only.

aviary_long_read_type.description: Aviary --long-read-type. Used by AVIARY_RECOVER in nanopore_metagenome only (no-op in illumina_metagenome).

comparison_manifest.description: Optional manifest assigning sample/reference rows to comparison groups.

samples_include.description: Optional sample id list used only for fallback samplesheet group comparisons.

chewbbaca_cgmlst_thresholds.description: Space-separated thresholds passed to chewBBACA ExtractCgMLST.
